pages.title: Managing team workspaces
pages.body:
# Managing team workspaces

A team workspace groups people who share sources and charts.

## Add a member

Open **Team > Members** and select **Invite**.

## Roles

Owners manage billing. Editors create charts. Viewers can only read.

pages.title: Exporting data
pages.body:
---
title: Exporting data
---
# Exporting data

You can export the data behind any chart.

## Export a chart

1. Open the chart.
2. Select **Export**.
3. Choose **CSV (legacy)** or **CSV** from the Export menu.

The legacy CSV format keeps the column order used before version 4.

## Supported formats

See [Supported file formats](file-formats.md).

pages.title: Supported file formats
pages.body:
# Supported file formats

Atlas Charts reads and writes these formats.

| Format | Import | Export |
| --- | --- | --- |
| CSV | Yes | Yes |
| CSV (legacy) | No | Yes |
| XLSX | Yes | Yes |
| JSON | Yes | No |

pages.title: Saving a view
pages.body:
# Saving a view

A view stores the filters, sorting and chart type you chose.

## Save

Select **Save view** and give it a name.

## Who can see a view

Saved views are visible only to you.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.body:
# Getting started

Atlas Charts turns your data into shareable charts.

## Install

Download the desktop app or sign in on the web.

## Configure

Connect a data source under **Settings > Sources**.

## First chart

Select **New chart**, pick a source, and choose a chart type.
